question: Generic relay variant (Fable round 4 idea 2): hand over the last information-dense 12,000 characters (latest window with zlib ratio >= 0.25, stepping back 2,000 characters) instead of the raw tail (43 % of tails are repetitive). Paired screen on the generic abstentions of hard-v18 (roll12cancel, roll12idle) and hard-v16 esc_none, deduplicated; only workers whose dense excerpt differs from the tail run, in both arms, with identical selection and seeds.
design: Two RELAY arms (window tail, window dense), each alone, each wrapped by inkling/account_cmd.py; unchanged judge; cancel on accept within an arm; verifier only scores.
decision_rule: roll12relay switches to the dense window (after the in-swarm study adopts relay) if dense rescues more cases than tail with 0 wrong; otherwise the tail stays. McNemar reported, descriptive (12 puzzles).
